name: Underwater life river Maas 01 190616_0035 0036.ogg
description: Underwater sound of Dutch river (hydroponic). A boat has sailed along this jetty. My hydrophones hang just below the water surface. What do you hear; 1] moving the jetty along the posts. 2] small waves. 3] animals that scrape alga from stones. name: Ditch UnderWater animal Noise 140720_0306.flac
description: Under water noise in a ditch in a farmland. Sounds like eating. Real strange noise recorded in that didge. Sometimes you hear an eating-noise. I could see the mics and there were no larger animals visual. When you listen carefully in the beginning you just hear the eating sound in the right microphone and not in the left one. After a while you hear the same noise at the left as well. Sometimes some bubbles come out of the thin mud. WHO KNOWS WHAT ANIMAL I HAVE RECORDED??? My wife did a search on the internet but could not find anything useful about sounds in fresh waters. Location: 51° 42' 38.00" N 5° 13' 49.00" E, ditch Voorste Zeedijk, polder Haarsteeg/'s-Hertogenbosch, The Netherlands. Conditions: summer, July 20th, 2014, 8pm, no wind.
